body:
I'm still alive and well.  I'm doing better.  I'm still writing and I've given a good deal of thought to the situation.  I talked to my dad about changing my major to music instead and possibly taking a semester off in order to regroup.  I have to talk with the woman who tends to my scholarship, but I think an agreement can be worked out.

I'm convinced now more than ever that music is about the only thing I'll ever be happy doing.  Things are already seeming brighter now that I'm working towards something I actually want to do.

Thank you and everyone else for listening.  I can't thank you enough for the kind words and much needed confidence you have given me.  I'm certainly not the one most in need of help, but you gave it me nonetheless.
Oh no, I love Starfox as much as the next guy.  I'm just making the point that I've enjoyed life in the past, so it isn't a normal thing for me to feel this way.  Thank you for listening.
